feature_representation_caveat: All models use the same source dataset and frozen evaluation split, but their internal representations are model-specific: SVM/Random Forest/XGBoost use TF-IDF word/char n-grams + count vectorizer + 23 deterministic CWE-89/CWE-295 security features; LSTM uses a from-scratch learned token embedding; CodeBERT uses a pretrained Transformer code representation, fine-tuned on this task. Representations are NOT identical across models.
note: Ranks are 1=best. No claim of 'CodeBERT is better' is made unless the table itself supports it.
